instruction: I want to know the video codec used in this file. Please use appropriate tools to identify the video codec and save it to a file named "codec.txt" in /home/user/ (write only the codec name, e.g., h264, h265, etc.).

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying the video codec using ffmpeg/ffprobe. MP4 files typically use h264/AVC codec. Evaluator checks if the identified codec is one of the valid h264 variants.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checking if the video codec is identified and saved to codec.txt
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the result file from VM at /home/user/codec.txt
Metric (check_video_codec__05e4689a) correctly reads the file content and compares it against the valid codecs list
Expected values are semantically correct: ['h264', 'avc', 'avc1'] are valid h264 codec identifiers commonly found in MP4 files
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: directly accesses expected.get('valid_codecs') which matches the rules dictionary returned by get_rule
Edge cases are handled: None results, file read errors, and case-insensitive comparison
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement in the instruction
